name: youtube-cloud-storage-flashdata
displayName: YouTube Download to Cloud Storage — FlashData
description: Deliver YouTube video, audio or clips to your own S3 or other supported cloud storage. Track asynchronous delivery and its output manifest. Uses the paid FlashData API.

FLASHDATA_API_KEY.title: FlashData API key
FLASHDATA_API_KEY.description: FlashData API key from https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys with youtube_download enabled. Data calls use paid Credits; pricing and job reads are free.
